title: Sum of Numbers from 1 to N
description: Read a non-negative integer N and print the sum of all integers from 1 through N. For N = 0, print 0.
output_format: Print the sum from 1 through N.

starter_code.Python:
n = int(input())
total = 0
for number in range(1, n + 1):
    total += number
print(total)

learning_content.title: Loops and accumulation
learning_content.intro: A loop repeats a block of code for a sequence of values. An accumulator stores the running total as each number is processed.
points: Continue while the current number is at most N.
Add the current number to total on every iteration.
learning_content.note: The loop visits each integer from 1 through N once.

quiz.question: When N = 4, what values are added to the running total?

options.feedback: The task starts adding at 1 and includes N.
The loop processes every integer from 1 through 4.
This omits the upper endpoint N = 4.

options.label: 4 only
options.feedback: The task asks for the sum of all preceding positive integers too.

quiz.explanation: The inclusive sequence from 1 through 4 is 1, 2, 3, 4.
